title: Identifying Living Things with Keys
summary: Use and build dichotomous keys: yes/no questions that lead to an organism's name.

ib.note: Keys are a core MYP skill (Criteria B and C)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: Diversity in the Living World

objectives: I can use a dichotomous key to identify organisms.
I can construct a dichotomous key using observable features.
I can explain why good key questions use features that can be clearly observed.
misconceptions: A key question can use opinions like ‘Is it pretty?’
Keys must use the same question order for every group.
Features like colour are always reliable.
